notes.problem: Stretched oak grain; the sheet floats on a wood field.
notes.fix: True-scale grain, and the paper stack and a monitor edge at the margin.

notes.problem: Top-down procedural grain smeared by blur behind the hook; the letter reads as a type plate; no window, wall depth or hour.
notes.fix: Seated eye at 1.2 m across the desk toward a sill-height window; true-scale oak; no global blur; the sheet with thickness, a curl and the sun patch.

notes.problem: Grain stretched into streaks, no room, the sheet a plate, the pen without contact.
notes.fix: Seated eye at 1.2 m so the window and wall fill the top third; oak at true board grain; contacts on the pen and sheet.

notes.problem: Mannequins with faces front on, blank concrete with dot pebbles, no shade band, dead sky.
notes.fix: Camera under the walkway behind the party so its shade crosses the foreground and all seven walk away; broom finish and a joint for the pebbles.

notes.problem: Mannequins on a void plane with pebble decals; two faces toward camera; an orphan shadow at the left horizon.
notes.fix: The walkway's shade band across the foreground; broom-finish concrete with joints; all seven turned away; delete the orphan shadow.

notes.problem: Mirrored-stride mannequins on a bare plain with dot pebbles; no dark.
notes.fix: The walkway's shade band across the foreground; no rock scatter on the walk; every walker turned away.

notes.problem: Three untextured boxes on a table read as a 3D bar chart.
notes.fix: Cast stone and tinted glass with bevels; a window raking light across the oak; the table edge in perspective.

notes.problem: Rounded boxes before an oversized blurred wall; the glass column cropped; the bottom 350 px a blurred table edge; no light direction.
notes.fix: Shoot along the table with all three columns inside the frame; a sill-height window's sun patch between them; true block scale; no wall blur.

notes.problem: Primitive boxes before a blank wall; the 10 block beside the footprint reads ambiguously.
notes.fix: A classroom table with side windows casting shadows; a tinted glass edge; the 10 block as a ghost outline over the footprint.

notes.problem: A flat box clock against bare sky and brick; nothing places it in Fort Davis.
notes.fix: Pull back and lower so the rimrock and grama sit behind the entry; hang the clock from the walkway's edge beam.

notes.problem: A box clock against a flat sky with a floating grey slab at the bottom; no ground, no place.
notes.fix: Back off and look up under the walkway so the clock hangs from the deck's edge beam over a ground line with the rimrock; delete the grey slab.

notes.problem: A slab clock on a brick corner against a gradient sky; a grey slab across the bottom.
notes.fix: Drop and widen so the clock hangs on the entry facade with the rimrock and a bus flank behind; crop the grey slab.

notes.problem: Ten chairs an uncountable tangle with the leftmost cropped; a dead grey pilaster on the left 130 px; 40 percent empty tile.
notes.fix: Two clean rows of five fully in frame filling the bottom third; crop out the pilaster; a window's sun patch on the limestone.
Lower and tilt the camera so the chair blocks sit on the lower third and crop the empty floor.

notes.problem: A fender sheet out of the front wheel arch near x 620 to 840, y 1570 of the 1600 px view.
notes.fix: Fix the front fender so the arch closes on the wheel and pan left to bring the oak's crown behind the parent.

notes.problem: A geometry spike at the front wheel arch; the arm flush to the body.
notes.fix: Repair the fender mesh; swing the arm out perpendicular to the bus side.

notes.problem: A halo ring in the upper sky; fog on the nearest road, so the haze runs backwards.
notes.fix: Remove the foreground fog so haze rises only with distance; dither the sky to kill the ring.
